notes.title: White Dots brings every Dots colour into one view for a household. This deck walks through the Lucknow prototype: a family of four, each with a different need, and one map of the help nearby.
notes.crisis: Figures are from the Blue Dots Ghaziabad deck (slide 4). The point for White Dots: a household's needs cut across many programmes, and today the family asks around for each one.
notes.voice: Each family member makes one call, in Hindi, to Parivar Saathi. The call captures who they are, what they have and what they want.
notes.map: This is the live prototype map: 44 sample dots across all nine colours, with the family's home in Alambagh. Filled pins offer help; white pins ask for it. All data is fictional.
notes.people: Two of the four personas. Aman wants a course that leads to a job; Sunita wants a scheme for her self-help group. The photos are generated for the prototype.
notes.needs: The left side is what one household asks for; the right side is who can help, across all nine colours. The quotes are from the use-case brief, not from real callers: the prototype has no call data yet.
notes.use_cases: Where White Dots sits: the 'one household' hub in the middle connects all the use cases.
notes.geographies: Where the approach is live, starting and in talks.
notes.thanks: Try it: the bot page and the map are live. Ask to see a call.
